# mtncloud_archive_buckets (Data Source)

Lists the archives (Tools > Archives) your tenant can see, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_archive_buckets" "all" {}

output "archive_names" {
  value = [for a in data.mtncloud_archive_buckets.all.archives : a.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `archives` (Attributes List) The archives. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--archives))
- `id` (String) Always `archive-buckets`.

<a id="nestedatt--archives"></a>
### Nested Schema for `archives`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Its description.
- `file_count` (Number) How many files it holds.
- `id` (String) The archive's ID.
- `mos_bucket_console_name` (String) That bucket's name in the console.
- `mos_bucket_id` (String) The console record ID of the MOS bucket its files are kept in (an `mtncloud_mos_bucket` ID).
- `name` (String) The archive's name.
- `owner` (String) The tenant that owns it.
- `public_url` (Boolean) Whether anyone can download its files without logging in.
- `size_bytes` (Number) The total size of its files, in bytes.
- `visibility` (String) `private` (its own tenant) or `public` (every tenant).
